measurements.quote: The erect stems grow to 1.5–4 m (4.9–13.1 ft) tall
The stems (culms) are typically 5–10 mm broad
The leaves are 18–60 centimetres (7.1–23.6 in) long

appearance.value: glaucous green to greyish-green, fading to buff-brown in autumn
appearance.quote: glaucous green to greyish-green, fading to buff-brown in autumn

appearance.value: dense, dark purple panicle in late summer
appearance.quote: in a dense, dark purple panicle

appearance.value: spikelets appear greyer from long, silky hairs that help disperse the minute seeds
appearance.quote: appear greyer due to the growth of long, silky hairs

architecture.value: erect stems (culms) that stay standing through the winter after the leaves fall
architecture.quote: before falling to leave the stems standing through the winter

architecture.value: horizontal runners that put down roots at regular intervals
architecture.quote: by horizontal runners, which put down roots at regular intervals

phenology.quote: The flowers are produced in late summer

phenology.when: leaves fade to buff-brown in autumn before falling
phenology.quote: fading to buff-brown in autumn before falling

propagation.fact: spreads 5 m or more per year by horizontal runners
propagation.quote: spread at 5 metres (16 feet) or more per year by horizontal runners

propagation.fact: long silky hairs help disperse the minute seeds

description.value: Tall wetland reed forming extensive stands, with erect stems 1.5-4 m tall, glaucous leaves and dense dark purple panicles.
description.quote: It is a wetland grass that can grow up to 2–6 metres (7–20 ft) tall

environment.value: Damp ground, standing water up to 1 m deep or floating mats; tallest in hot summers and fertile conditions.
environment.quote: It can grow in damp ground, in standing water up to 1 m (3 ft 3 in) deep, or as a floating mat

flowers.quote: The flowers are produced in late summer in a dense, dark purple panicle
